entities.summary: Wehrmacht Propaganda Troops was a branch of service of the Wehrmacht and the Waffen-SS of Nazi Germany during World War II. Subordinated to the High Command of the Wehrmacht, its function was to produce and disseminate propaganda materials aimed at the German troops and the population.
